saw_lines: Nobody buys cleaner for fun. They search the mold or stain in front of them, then search again when it returns.
So the sale is won in the first line of the search ad, where the problem is named before the brand.
Your 88 Google creatives split into 15 text, 18 image and 7 video, so build three new text ads naming the mold and brown stain problems from your site.
ads_1: Problem-first Google text ads for mold and stain, tested against product names
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
